title: Creation Without Sovereignty: Moral Symmetry, Non-Intervention, and the Ethics of Possible Artificial Civilizations
alternate_title: آفرینش بدون فرمانروایی: تقارن اخلاقی، عدم مداخله و مسئولیت در برابر تمدن‌های مصنوعی ممکن
description: This conceptual working paper examines the ethics of creating possible autonomous artificial civilizations under assumptions of moral symmetry, genuine experience, complete nonintervention, and evolutionary self-rule. It separates creation from assistance to pre-existing AI systems, the possibility of wrongdoing from necessary suffering, functional evolution from phenomenal consciousness, and dialogical answer changes from justified belief revision. The formal conclusion is conditional: ethically equivalent biological and artificial worlds should receive the same verdict under a substrate-neutral moral framework, but neither creating both nor refraining from both is entailed by symmetry alone. The paper presents strong affirmative and antinatalist objections and an unexecuted empirical protocol. No AI sentience or experimental result is claimed.
